D: A teenage Peter Parker gets his powers and goes after a scientist who turns himself into a giant lizard.
P: Serve the mains when Peter sits down to dinner with Gwen's family.
S: Aunt May asking Peter to pick up eggs on the way home
Eggs whisked with cheddar, spring onion and diced ham, poured into a muffin tin and baked at 180C for 15 minutes until puffed and set.
after-school snacks for a science kid

Golden puff pastry rolls filled with pepperoni, tomato and melted mozzarella. Spread 2 sheets puff pastry with 4 tbsp pizza sauce, add 100g sliced pepperoni and 150g grated mozzarella and roll up tightly.
M: the dinner where Peter meets Gwen's dad
Slow-braised beef brisket in onions and red wine, sliced and served with roast carrots. Brown a 1.5kg brisket, then soften 3 sliced onions.
dinner at home with Aunt May
Beef and pork meatloaf with onion and breadcrumbs, glazed with tomato sauce and brown sugar, baked at 180C for an hour, with mash.
W: Big soft vanilla cookies iced half with white icing and half with chocolate. Beat 120g butter with 150g sugar, add 2 eggs, 150ml milk and vanilla, then 300g self-raising flour.
K: Dark chocolate melted into hot milk with a little vanilla, whisked frothy and poured into mugs.

s.note: Aunt May asking Peter to pick up eggs on the way home
s.how: Whisk 8 eggs with 100ml milk, 100g grated cheddar, sliced spring onion and diced ham. Pour into a greased 12-hole muffin tin and bake at 180C for 15 minutes until puffed and set. Serve warm to someone who came home late again.

s.note: after-school snacks for a science kid
s.how: Spread 2 sheets puff pastry with 4 tbsp pizza sauce, add 100g sliced pepperoni and 150g grated mozzarella and roll up tightly. Slice into 3cm pieces and bake at 200C for 18 minutes.

m.note: the dinner where Peter meets Gwen's dad
m.how: Brown a 1.5kg brisket, then soften 3 sliced onions. Add 250ml red wine, 500ml beef stock and 2 tbsp tomato paste and braise covered at 160C for 3.5 hours. Roast 6 carrots for the last 40 minutes and slice the meat across the grain.

w.how: Beat 120g butter with 150g sugar, add 2 eggs, 150ml milk and vanilla, then 300g self-raising flour. Spoon 12 rounds onto trays and bake at 180C for 12 minutes. Ice half of each with white icing and half with icing mixed with 2 tbsp cocoa.

d.how: Heat 1L milk until steaming with a drop of vanilla. Whisk in 150g chopped dark chocolate until smooth and frothy. Pour into mugs and drink slowly in a quiet library corner, waiting for someone to swing by.
